notes.title: Demo Launch and Feedback!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014503/21980fce65aaefc739ae3944b938afc45209d427.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Wow![/h3][p]Thank you to everyone who's taken the time to download the demo and give it a try! We couldn't be happier with the positive reception, and we're excited to continue this development journey alongside all of you.[/p][p]So, to everyone who's downloaded the demo, Wishlisted, streamed the game, posted on social media, or helped spread the word in any way, THANK YOU from the entire Sunsgrove Studios team![/p][h3]So, What's Next?[/h3][p]We're going to try and chase down a few bugs that you've noticed in the demo, including a frankly hilarious one where sometimes all the lip sync for a single VO line plays at light speed! That's a new one! We'll try and get to the bottom of that.[/p][p]There are also some more obvious scripting fixes we can make, and we'll try and wrap all those up into a demo update build sometime soon.[/p][h3]But What's NEXT-next?[/h3][p]The demo's reception has been absolutely incredible, and we want to take all that amazing feedback and fold it right back into the game! We're already building out new scenes, characters, and animations for the areas just beyond where the demo ends--and while there's a lot left to do, we're excited to share this journey with you![/p][p]Be sure to follow us at the links below for more regular updates on the development of [i]War of the Western Deep[/i]![/p]
